title: Muvaki Wezvipingamupinyi
intro: Munyika dzakakura, mumwe munhu ane simba akatanga rwendo rwakatevedzana, akapa simba guru uye pfuma. Mweya uyu wakasangana nenharaunda dzakasiyana-siyana uye wakatarisana nematambudziko akasiyana, zvichisiya chiratidzo chisingaperi munhoroondo nekutenda kuburikidza nezviito zvavo neuchenjeri hwavo, zvese izvi zvichiratidza kuti ndivo chaivo vaipa simba ravo.
clues: Ndakapiwa simba nezvinhu zvose, uye ndakatevera nzira.
Rwendo rwangu rwakandiendesa kunzvimbo yekuvira kwezuva, kwandakawana vanhu.
Ndakasangana nenzanga yaisanzwisisa mutauro, yaigara pakati pemakomo maviri.
Ndakakumbirwa kuti ndivake chipingamupinyi, kwete chekuzviwanira pfuma, asi chekudzivirira kubva kusimba rinoparadza.
Ndakazivisa kuti simba rekuvaka rusvingo urwu rukuru rakabva kuna Allah, uye raizomira kusvika panguva yakapikirwa.
Zita rangu, rinowanzo shandurwa sekuti 'Iye Ane Nyanga Mbiri,' rinoreva kusvika kwangu panyika kana kuti pamwe nguva mbiri dzakasiyana.
arabic: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّى فِيهِ رَبِّى خَيْرٌۭ فَأَعِينُونِى بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا
verse: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength [i.e., manpower]; I will make between you and them a dam. (18:95)
